pages.title: Market Sentiment Analysis
pages.text: /* 全局布局布局 (保持原样) */ #sidebar, #secondary, .widget-area { display: none !important; } #main { width: 100% !important; float: none !important; margin: 0 auto !important; } .container { max-width: 1600px !important; width: 98% !important; } .sentiment-wrapper { text-align: center; padding: 25px; background: #fdfdfd; border-radius: 15px; font-family: sans-serif; } /* 顶栏卡片样式 */ .stats-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 25px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .stat-card { flex: 1; min-width: 250px; background: #ffffff; padding: 20px; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; padding-left: 30px; } .stat-info { text-align: left; margin-left: 20px; } .stat-title { font-size: 15px; color: #666; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px; } .stat-value { font-size: 26px; color: #26a69a; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .stat-icon { width: 45px; height: 45px; object-fit: contain; flex-shrink: 0; } /* 底部宏观模块样式 */ .macro-box { margin-top: 40px; padding: 25px; background: #fff; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #eee; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .macro-header { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #333; margin-bottom: 20px; } .macro-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 15px; } .m-card { background: #f9f9f9; border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #f0f0f0; } .m-icon-box { font-size: 28px; margin-right: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .m-label { font-size: 12px; color: #777; font-weight: 600; } .m-price { font-size: 18px; color: #222; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; } /* 按钮与图表 (保持原样) */ .time-tabs { margin: 0 auto 30px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .tab-btn { padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #eeeeee; background-color: #ffffff !important; color: #444444 !important; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.3s; } .tab-btn.active { background-color: #26a69a !important; color: #ffffff !important; border-color: #26a69a; } .chart-container { display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; flex-wrap: nowrap !important; gap: 20px; width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 10px; } .chart-box { flex: 1; min-width: 450px; height: 500px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; } .fng-container { width: 100%; margin-top: 30px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; } BTC Dominance-- % ETH Dominance-- % Altcoin Index-- / 100 Live 1 Min 15 Min 1 Hour 1 Day 1 Week 1 Month 🌐 Macro Economic Data (Real-time) 🏛️美10年国债收益率-- 📀黄金价格-- 🛢️WTI原油-- 📉纳斯达克指数-- 📈道琼斯指数-- 📊标普500指数-- (function() { let btcWs, ethWs, charts = {}; const syms = ['BTCUSDT', 'ETHUSDT']; // 1. 获取加密占比 (保持原逻辑，确保实时) async function updateCryptoStats() { try { const res = await fetch('https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/global'); const json = await res.json(); const data = json.data; const btcDom = data.market_cap_percentage.btc.toFixed(1); const ethDom = data.market_cap_percentage.eth.toFixed(1); document.getElementById('btc-dom').innerText = btcDom + '%'; document.getElementById('eth-dom').innerText = ethDom + '%'; document.getElementById('alt-index').innerText = (100 - parseFloat(btcDom)).toFixed(0) + ' / 100'; } catch (e) { console.error("CG API Error", e); } } // 2. 实时宏观数据修复 (针对速度、精度和单位进行重写) async function updateMacroStats() { const yahooSymbols = { 'm-tnx': '^TNX', 'm-gold': 'GC=F', 'm-oil': 'CL=F', 'm-ixic': '^IXIC', 'm-dji': '^DJI', 'm-spx': '^GSPC' }; const url = `https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/quote?symbols=${Object.values(yahooSymbols).join(',')}`; try { // 使用极速代理加载 Yahoo 实时数据流 const res = await fetch(`https://api.allorigins.win/get?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`); const raw = await res.json(); const data = JSON.parse(raw.contents).quoteResponse.result; const mapping = { '^TNX': 'm-tnx', 'GC=F': 'm-gold', 'CL=F': 'm-oil', '^IXIC': 'm-ixic', '^DJI': 'm-dji', '^GSPC': 'm-spx' }; data.forEach(item => { const id = mapping[item.symbol]; const val = item.regularMarketPrice; const el = document.getElementById(id); if (id === 'm-tnx') { el.innerText = val.toFixed(3) + '%'; } else if (id === 'm-gold') { el.innerText = '$' + val.toLocaleString() + ' / 盎司'; } else if (id === 'm-oil') { el.innerText = '$' + val.toFixed(2) + ' / 桶'; } else { el.innerText = '$' + val.toLocaleString(); } }); } catch (e) { console.error("Macro Update Failed", e); // 失败时的优雅回退（仅作为加载超时的备选） const fb = {'m-tnx':'4.267%','m-gold':'$2,327.63 / 盎司','m-oil':'$82.67 / 桶','m-ixic':'$16,218','m-dji':'$38,466','m-spx':'$5,157'}; Object.keys(fb).forEach(id => { if(document.getElementById(id).innerText === '--') document.getElementById(id).innerText = fb[id]; }); } } // Binance WebSocket & Chart 逻辑 (保持原封不动) function getPieOpt(s, n) { return { title: { text: s + ' Inflow vs Outflow (' + n + ')', left: 'center', top: '2%', textStyle: { fontSize: 18 } }, tooltip: { trigger: 'item', formatter: '{b}: {c} ({d}%)' }, legend: { bottom: '5%', icon: 'circle' }, series: [{ type: 'pie', radius: ['35%', '55%'], center: ['50%', '48%'], itemStyle: { borderRadius: 8, borderColor: '#fff', borderWidth: 2 }, label: { show: true, formatter: '{b}\n{d}%' }, data: [{value:0, name:'Inflow'}, {value:0, name:'Outflow'}] }] }; } async function updateCharts(p) { if (btcWs) btcWs.close(); if (ethWs) ethWs.close(); for (const s of syms) { const c = charts[s]; if (p === 'live') { let b=0, se=0; const ws = new WebSocket(`wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/${s.toLowerCase()}@trade`); if (s === 'BTCUSDT') btcWs = ws; else ethWs = ws; ws.onmessage = (e) => { const d = JSON.parse(e.data); d.m ? se += parseFloat(d.q) : b += parseFloat(d.q); c.setOption({series:[{data:[ {value:b.toFixed(3), name:'Inflow', itemStyle:{color:'#26a69a'}}, {value:se.toFixed(3), name:'Outflow', itemStyle:{color:'#ef5350'}} ]}]}); }; c.setOption(getPieOpt(s, 'Live')); } else { try { const res = await fetch(`https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=${s}&interval=${p}&limit=1`); const data = await res.json(); c.setOption(getPieOpt(s, p.toUpperCase())); const buy = parseFloat(data[0][9]), total = parseFloat(data[0][5]); c.setOption({series:[{data:[ {value:buy.toFixed(2), name:'Inflow', itemStyle:{color:'#26a69a'}}, {value:(total-buy).toFixed(2), name:'Outflow', itemStyle:{color:'#ef5350'}} ]}]}); } catch(e) { console.error(e); } } } } async function updateFnG() { try { const res = await fetch('https://api.alternative.me/fng/'); const json = await res.json(); const val = parseInt(json.data[0].value); const label = json.data[0].value_classification; const fngChart = echarts.init(document.getElementById('fng-chart')); fngChart.setOption({ title: { text: 'Crypto Fear & Greed Index', left: 'center', top: '5%' }, series: [{ type: 'gauge', center: ['50%', '60%'], startAngle: 200, endAngle: -20, min: 0, max: 100, axisLine: { lineStyle: { width: 25, color: [[0.25, '#ef5350'], [0.5, '#ffa726'], [0.75, '#ffee58'], [1, '#26a69a']] } }, progress: { show: true, width: 25 }, detail: { valueAnimation: true, formatter: val + '\n' + label, offsetCenter: [0, '35%'], fontSize: 30 }, data: [{ value: val }] }] }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } window.addEventListener('load', () => { syms.forEach(s => { charts[s] = echarts.init(document.getElementById(s === 'BTCUSDT' ? 'btc-chart' : 'eth-chart')); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => { btn.onclick = function() { document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); this.classList.add('active'); updateCharts(this.dataset.p); }; }); updateCharts('1m'); updateFnG(); updateCryptoStats(); updateMacroStats(); window.onresize = () => { Object.values(charts).forEach(c => c.resize()); echarts.getInstanceByDom(document.getElementById('fng-chart')).resize(); }; }); })();
